brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested Hammam Khazem, son of deceased fighter Fathi Khazem known as "Abu Raed," during a raid on his home in Jenin, northern West Bank, Shehab Wire reported Monday. The arrest followed a military operation targeting the residence in the Palestinian city.

Local sources confirmed the detention took place following the house search. Khazem's father, Fathi Khazem, was a figure previously killed during the conflict in the region. The specific reasons for the arrest, any formal charges against the detainee, and details of the military operation remain unclear at this time.
